nfl.oneThing: The Lions beat the Vikings 19–15 to end Minnesota's unbeaten start. Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 153 yards, and Jared Goff hit Jameson Williams with a go-ahead touchdown with 4:35 left.

headlines.title: Lions end the Vikings' unbeaten run
headlines.summary: Detroit beat Minnesota 19–15 at home, handing the NFL's last undefeated team its first loss. Gibbs scored on a 30-yard, tackle-breaking run in the third quarter. Goff found Williams for a 7-yard touchdown late in the fourth. Goff finished 18 of 25 for 176 yards with his first interception of the season. Kyler Murray went 17 of 29 for 210 yards with two touchdowns and an interception. The Vikings were outgained 384 yards to 266 and had only 81 rushing yards. Minnesota's defence had four sacks of Goff but couldn't hold a late lead.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Vikings are still 6-1 and the NFC's No. 2 seed. The Lions move to 5-2, sitting fifth in the NFC, and have won three straight, including their first two NFC North games.

headlines.title: Lamar Jackson hurt on the first play as Ravens fall to Bills
headlines.summary: Jackson hurt his right thumb on his first snap of his first game back from a high ankle sprain, which kept him out for three games. He was ruled out for the rest of the 36–10 loss to Buffalo. Backup Tyler Huntley also left with a toe injury. Undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano went 10 of 21 for 91 yards with an interception. Derrick Henry ran 11 times for 53 yards and a touchdown. ESPN's injury piece says this is the most injury-filled season of Jackson's nine-year career.
headlines.whyItMatters: Baltimore is 4-4 and one game behind the last AFC playoff spot. Buffalo, at 6-1, remains the AFC's No. 1 seed.

headlines.title: Buccaneers win 16–0 without completing a pass
headlines.summary: Baker Mayfield was 0 of 3 in the rain, but Tampa Bay beat Atlanta 16–0 on the ground. Bucky Irving ran for 170 yards and a touchdown on 27 carries. Kenny Gainwell added 140 yards on 25 carries. The Buccaneers rushed for 324 yards, a team record for a single game. They became the first team since Buffalo in September 1974 to finish a game with zero completions. Michael Penix Jr. was 8 of 24 for 125 yards with four interceptions for Atlanta.
headlines.whyItMatters: Both teams are 3-5. Neither is in the NFC's top seven.

headlines.title: Jaguars rout Colts 42–7
headlines.summary: Trevor Lawrence threw three touchdown passes, one to Brian Thomas Jr., who had recently been benched. Jacksonville also had big plays on defence. Indianapolis had traded guard Quenton Nelson and defensive tackle DeForest Buckner earlier in the week. Jacksonville has now won 12 straight home games against the Colts.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Jaguars are 5-2 and the AFC's No. 4 seed. The Colts drop to 2-6 and have lost four straight.

headlines.title: Steelers take AFC North lead with 27–6 win over Browns
headlines.summary: Jaylen Warren ran for 143 yards and a touchdown on his 28th birthday, tying his career high. Pittsburgh extended its home winning streak over Cleveland to 23 straight. Aaron Rodgers was 13 of 25 for 172 yards with an interception. Harold Fannin Jr. had 10 catches for 154 yards for the Browns, who lost the division lead.
headlines.whyItMatters: Pittsburgh is 6-2 and the AFC's No. 3 seed, now first in the AFC North. Cleveland is 5-3 and the No. 7 seed.

recaps.text: Detroit's second-half run game did the work. Gibbs broke free on a 30-yard touchdown in the third quarter, and then powered a fourth-quarter drive that ended with Goff's throw to Williams. The Vikings had four sacks of Goff, but couldn't hold the lead. Detroit is now 5-2, and it's a big result in the NFC North race.

recaps.keyLine: Cousins 19/26, 247 yds, 3 TD · Bowers 7 rec, 92 yds, 2 TD · Smith 20/32, 290 yds, 2 TD, 1 INT · Mitchell 7 rec, 142 yds, 1 TD
recaps.text: The Raiders needed a late stop and a late kick to end their four-game losing streak in a high-scoring game. Dylan Laube's 95-yard kickoff return touchdown briefly gave Las Vegas the lead in the second quarter, but the Jets took a 23–14 halftime lead after a series of long drives. Kirk Cousins threw three touchdowns, including a two-yard pass to Jalen Nailor that put the Raiders ahead 35–30 with 11:33 left. Jeremy Chinn's interception helped, and Matt Gay's 53-yard field goal with 27 seconds left sealed it. The Raiders improve to 4-4, and the Jets' defence and special teams are the story for New York.

recaps.keyLine: Penix Jr. 8/24, 125 yds, 0 TD, 4 INT · Dotson 2 rec, 95 yds · Mayfield 0/3, 0 yds, 0 TD · Irving 27 car, 170 yds, 1 TD
recaps.text: Tampa Bay ran the ball on almost every snap in the rain and sloppy conditions. Irving and Gainwell both had 25 or more carries, something that had never happened before in NFL history. Atlanta's offence was ineffective, and Penix's four interceptions ended any chance of a comeback. The Buccaneers' record-setting rushing day is the headline, but it also shows how much the Falcons' passing game failed.

Bhayshul Tuten scored on the ground and through the air, and the Jaguars' defence forced turnovers. Indianapolis, already 2-6, lost further ground after trading two key veterans during the week.

contextCard.title: How NFL wild-card seeding works
contextCard.body: Each conference has seven playoff spots. The four division winners take seeds 1 to 4, ordered by record. The other three spots, the wild cards, go to the best remaining records, seeded 5 to 7. That's why a team with a losing division can still reach the playoffs if it has a strong record. Keep an eye on the wild-card race when a division leader is struggling.

headlines.title: Grizzlies roll over the winless Kings
headlines.summary: Memphis beat Sacramento 136–105. Cameron Boozer scored 27 points with nine rebounds, and the Grizzlies are off to a 6-0 start. Darius Acuff Jr. led Sacramento with 38 points, nine three-pointers, five rebounds and five assists, but it wasn't enough. Acuff is averaging 26.3 points per game, the most among NBA rookies. The Kings have lost six straight and are still winless.
headlines.whyItMatters: Memphis is 6-0 and the West's No. 1 seed. Sacramento is 0-6 and 15th in the West.

headlines.title: Maxey's 38 points carry 76ers past Hornets
headlines.summary: Philadelphia beat Charlotte 109–104. Tyrese Maxey scored 38 points with four rebounds and four assists. Grayson Allen had 27 points and seven threes for the Hornets, and Brandon Miller added 24 points, five rebounds and five assists. The Hornets lost a close game despite a strong effort from both players.
headlines.whyItMatters: Philadelphia is 6-1 and the East's top seed. Chicago, 1-5 and 13th in the East, has now lost four straight.

headlines.title: Rockets bounce back against Thunder
headlines.summary: Houston beat Oklahoma City 119–98. Jabari Smith Jr. scored 30 points with nine rebounds, five assists and six three-pointers, and Marcus Smart added 24 points and seven threes. Alperen Sengun had 16 points and nine assists.
headlines.whyItMatters: Houston is 6-1 and the West's No. 2 seed. Oklahoma City, now 4-2, is fifth in the West.

teamNews.title: Wembanyama's 43-point night
teamNews.text: Wembanyama took a career-high 34 shots and scored a season-high 43 points in the 121–111 win over Minnesota. It was the first time the Spurs won in a game where he took 30 or more shots. They had lost the two previous times he reached that mark. The Spurs have now won four straight.

teamNews.title: Harper and Fox support Wembanyama
teamNews.text: Dylan Harper had 25 points, seven rebounds and six assists. De'Aaron Fox had 22 points, eight rebounds and seven assists. Local coverage said Fox's leadership is powering the team as much as his scoring.

teamNews.title: Stephon Castle played through a migraine
teamNews.text: According to the San Antonio Express-News, Castle shook off a migraine to play against Minnesota. Another report said he scored no points in the game.
